subject: Re: Status - go/no-go call: scoped yes
body:
Go/no-go, as promised for the 26th.

It's a scoped yes. We productize the correction as an opt-in Corpus pipeline stage with a hard guardrail: minimum 200 samples per batch, otherwise the stage refuses to run rather than silently destroying signal. Umar's -0.4 nDCG result is the reason the guardrail exists and I want that in the doc, not buried.

We are NOT claiming this as a general de-batching layer. That was my framing in March and Umar's numbers didn't support it.

Alina - the re-ingest with per-run metadata still needs to happen for the pilot corpus. You've got it planned against the 2026-07-24 Corpus v2 freeze, which leaves float, so let's use some of it: I'd rather Amara land it in the first half of July than sprint. Jun, flagging you for visibility on the ingest ask.

Anders
